title: MEUBLE COSY Ergonomic Office Chair, Swivel Seat, Height Adjustable, Computer Chair, No Armrest, for Home Office, Study and Bedroom, Coral Pink
description: Still looking for the perfect office chair? A chair that combines ergonomic comfort, practicality and modern design to accompany your days of work or study? At MEUBLE COSY, we design furniture designed to improve your everyday life while bringing a touch of elegance to your home. This ergonomic office chair features a curved S-shaped backrest that naturally contours to the curvature of the back and promotes a comfortable sitting posture. Its generously padded seat with high-density foam and covered with breathable mesh provides long-lasting comfort, even for long hours in front of the computer. Thanks to its adjustable height, 360° rotation and smooth wheels, this office chair easily adapts to your needs and your work space. Compact, colourful and easy to fit into an office, student bedroom or home office space, it brings a good mood to your daily life. With its contemporary design, robust structure and meticulous finishes, this computer chair is much more than just a seat: it is an ally of comfort and productivity designed to accompany you every day. Create a pleasant and inspiring workspace with MEUBLE COSY.
feature_bullets: 【Ergonomic Office Chair】Ergonomic S-shaped backrest provides excellent lumbar support. This ergonomic office chair helps maintain a comfortable posture while working, studying or teleworking.
【Comfortable and Breathable Seat】High density foam padded seat with breathable mesh cover. This computer chair ensures long-lasting comfort and limits the sensations of warmth during prolonged use.
【Adjustable Height and Colorful Design】Adjustable office chair with a seat height of 44 to 54cm to fit different users. Compact and colourful, this chair brings a good mood to your daily workspace.
【360° Rotation and Smooth Wheels】Swivel chair equipped with silent multi-directional casters. Move freely between your desk, computer and workspace with great ease.

【Strong Structure and Gift Idea】Desk chair without armrests with a sturdy PP structure and reinforced metal base. Its modern and compact design makes it an excellent choice for an office, a student's room, or as a practical and elegant gift.
